title: DebugOutput
description: Output produced by Agent C (Tester & Debugger) in the debugging stage. Given a failing test_output.json from the tester, Agent C analyzes the failures, attempts a fix on the code under test, and re-runs the tests to verify the fix.

status.description: Overall result of the debug stage.

tested_file.description: Filename of the Agent B module that was debugged (e.g. product_manager.py).

mode.description: How the fix was generated: Qwen repair, the deterministic mock fixer fallback, or test_repair when the failure was in Agent C's own generated test file.

fix_target.description: Which artifact was repaired: the code under test, or Agent C's own generated test file (for collection/import errors).

retry_used.description: Whether a fallback was triggered during fix generation (mirrors Agent B's convention).

retry_reason.description: Reason a fallback was used, or 'none'.

fix_syntax_check.description: ast.parse result for the proposed fixed code ('passed' or an error message).

fix_attempted.description: False only when status is no_failures; true whenever a fix was generated.

applied_fixes.description: Human-readable list of the transforms applied or recommended.

analysis.description: Per-failure root-cause analysis derived from the tester's failure list.

test.description: pytest node id of the failing test.

category.description: Root-cause category inferred from the traceback.

explanation.description: Plain-language explanation of the likely root cause.

traceback_summary.description: Trimmed traceback text from the sandbox run.

before.description: Pass/fail counts reported by the tester before the fix.

after.description: Pass/fail counts after re-running the tests against the fixed code.

verified.description: True only if tests actually executed (total > 0) and zero failed after the fix.

fixed_code.description: The corrected module that was re-verified in the sandbox (omitted when status is no_failures).

fixed_test_code.description: The corrected generated test module, present when fix_target is test_file (a collection/import error was repaired on the test side).
